title: Customer Questionnaire Translator and Prioritized Action Plan
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Create a reusable translator that maps customer security/compliance questionnaires (vendor RFIs, SOC2/ISO checklists, HIPAA prompts, GDPR/DPA questions) to Redwood-specific evidence artifacts and a prioritized action plan. The translator should produce a ranked set of discrete remediation tasks and a suggested contract clause language bundle for common exceptions, enabling faster response times and consistent answers across sales and customer success.
acceptance_criteria: Given a vendor questionnaire PDF/CSV or a typical SOC2 checklist, the translator produces a JSON list of mapped Redwood evidences and a ranked action plan (priority + owner + ETA) for >= 85% of items
Generated contract clause suggestions are reviewed and approved by Legal and Security in an initial sample of 10 common exceptions
Results are surfaced in the Customer Intake UI and exportable as a one-click response bundle (evidence + suggested text + delta to full compliance)
Processor integrates with existing evidence store links (Confluence/GDrive) and attaches supporting artifacts to the response bundle
proposed_solution: Build a three-stage pipeline: 1) parser that ingests questionnaires (PDF/CSV/Survey), 2) mapping engine that normalizes questions to a canonical taxonomy (data residency, encryption, access controls, retention, processing purposes), and 3) prioritizer that outputs an action plan with estimated effort tiers and recommended contractual language. Start with a curated taxonomy of 120 high-frequency questions derived from recent customer requests.
milestones: M1 - Taxonomy & sample set (deliverable: canonical mapping of 120 questions) - 2025-02-28
M2 - Parser + mapping prototype (deliverable: mapping pipeline + sample mappings) - 2025-03-14
M3 - Prioritizer + UI mockups (deliverable: prioritized action plan and UI flows) - 2025-03-31
M4 - Legal & Security review + pilot with 3 accounts (deliverable: approved clause library + pilot results) - 2025-04-10
M5 - Export bundle + documentation (deliverable: one-click response bundle + KB article) - 2025-04-15
risks: Mapping edge cases where customer language is ambiguous could require manual review and increase SLA
Legal sign-off on suggested contract language may iterate several times, delaying pilot
Integration with multiple evidence repositories (Confluence, Drive, internal S3) will require connector work from Eng
Overfitting to sample questionnaires could reduce generalization to enterprise-specific custom forms
